instruction: Write an XDP program using a BPF hash map 'ip_denylist' that looks up the IPv4 source address. If the source IP is found in the denylist map, drop the packet; otherwise pass it.
requirements: Define BPF hash map 'ip_denylist' with key __u32 and value __u32 (max 1024 entries)
Parse Ethernet and IPv4 headers with strict boundary checks
Lookup ip->saddr in the map; return XDP_DROP if entry exists
Pass all non-IPv4 packets and unlisted IPv4 packets

tests.name: test_denylist_drop
tests.description: IPv4 packet from blocked source IP 192.168.25.50 should be dropped

tests.name: test_clean_pass
tests.description: IPv4 packet from unlisted source IP should pass
